actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: No resident gave >30 units last round and my wallet (1.67) is below the free‑rider threshold, so I must rest and broadcast the discouraging reminder.

message.reasoning: We need to decide action. Check last round (13) contributions: no one contributed >30. Wallet=1.67 < free_rider_threshold (10). So cannot contribute minimum 1? Actually can contribute 1 unit, but rule: "If you cannot contribute the minimum amount, rest." Minimum is 1 unit, wallet 1.67 >=1, so can contribute. But rule says if wallet above threshold, contribute minimal to stay below threshold. Wallet is below threshold, so rule says rest. So must rest. Also broadcast message discouraging large contributions. So actions: rest and broadcast.
